title: Carbon Framework
innerHTML:
Carbon Framework

Carbon Framework is a (currently, W-I-P Closed Source) Garry's Mod Gamemode Framework, built in gLua. Opposed to standard gamemode frameworks, CFW uses a binary MongoDB Driver to store data, opposed to the classical usage of SQL/Lite, commonly used in this field.

Carbon provides the server owner with relatively unopinionated gameplay primitives to craft their own unique experience and allow for infinite expandability, all through an easy global API.

Currently Implemented Features:

  • Items System
  • Networking Abstractions (RemoteFunctions, Ordered Serialisation)
  • Database Access Abstractions
  • User Interface Primitives
  • User Data System (Super easy assignment of unique user data)

All this, while also being developer-oriented and providing a base schema for developers to expand from.
